body.purpose: Educational copy, metadata, validation, and supporting text.

label.purpose: Buttons, chips, compact coordinates, and small UI states.

shadows.name: tooltip-lift
shadows.purpose: Transient map capture tooltip floating above variable map content.

motion.name: state-reveal
motion.value: Material AnimatedVisibility with fade and vertical slide where implemented

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest action button for save, download, retry, and permission actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2E6A4F; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1px; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1B4332; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5FBF8A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Tonal secondary action for cancel, retry alternatives, and offline fallback choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #E3EAE3; color: #3E5A4A; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #5C7565; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1px; transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #C9EBD4; border-color: #2E6A4F; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5FBF8A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or failed-state action using the single app error red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #B3261E; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1px; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #93000A; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFB4AB; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Flat tonal container for park presets, downloaded maps, forms, and empty states.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #14241B; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; border: 0; box-shadow: none; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 17px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #3E5A4A; font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; }

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Material outlined field for species names, notes, and map coordinates.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #3E5A4A; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { min-height: 56px; border: 1px solid #5C7565; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #14241B; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #2E6A4F; outline: 2px solid #C9EBD4; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact mode switch for map filters such as journal versus global sightings.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #C9EBD4; color: #0C3320; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 28px; font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #2E6A4F; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5FBF8A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Map Tooltip
components.description: Elevated selected-capture overlay with thumbnail, species, scientific name, and coordinates.
components.css: .ds-map-tooltip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #14241B; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(7, 20, 14, 0.24); font-family: 'Fira Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-thumb { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #C9EBD4; color: #0C3320; } .ds-map-tooltip strong { display: block; font-size: 17px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-map-tooltip em { display: block; color: #3E5A4A; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-map-tooltip small { display: block; color: #5C7565; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; }

components.name: Camera Chrome Action
components.description: Circular camera affordance: dark chrome, bright forest outline, high contrast touch target.
components.css: .ds-camera-action { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(7, 20, 14, 0.7); border: 1.5px solid #5FBF8A; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-camera-action span { width: 26px; height: 20px; border: 2px solid #5FBF8A; border-radius: 4px; position: relative; } .ds-camera-action span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #5FBF8A; right: 3px; top: 3px; } .ds-camera-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #E6F3EA; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: PataGOnIA is a field notebook that happens to be a mobile app: serious enough to be trusted for species identification and citizen-science records, alive enough to make learning biodiversity feel inviting. The interface must feel adult, reliable, and educational without becoming dry. It uses a restrained forest system, crisp contrast, real typography, and Material-native controls so the user can keep moving on trail.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained forest-green palette with one primary accent used for action, selection, and status.
High-contrast ink on green-tinted neutrals for outdoor readability.
Forced dark capture flow for camera, review, and first-run loading.
Fira Sans throughout: humanist, readable, offline bundled, never decorative.
Tactile but sober controls: clear touch targets, modest radii, no cartoon surfaces.

rules.name: The One Forest Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary green is for action, selected state, focus, and progress. Do not use it as decoration across every card.

rules.name: The No Beige Field Rule
rules.body: Warmth is carried by copy, species imagery, and earth secondary roles. Do not use cream, sand, parchment, or paper neutrals as the body background.

rules.name: The Outdoor Contrast Rule
rules.body: If secondary text starts to feel elegant but pale, it is wrong. Push it toward ink-variant or mint-variant until it reads at a glance outdoors.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second typeface for flavor. Product trust comes from consistent Fira Sans hierarchy.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Cards, forms, and download panels are separated by surface tokens and spacing before shadows. If a static card needs a shadow to be understood, the surface hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do keep the primary context sentence in mind: hikers use this outdoors in bright Patagonia light, often one-handed and offline.
Do use forest-primary only for action, selected state, focus, and progress.
Do use CaptureTheme for camera, review, and first-run loading when dark camera chrome is the correct UX.
Do use Material Icons for actions and states; give interactive icons clear content descriptions.
Do keep cards flat and tonal unless they are true overlays.
Do write empty and error states that teach the next action, especially offline readiness.
donts: Don't create an App de caricatura/juguete: no toy saturation, cartoon wildlife, emoji iconography, or Pokemon-like capture language.
Don't create Densidad de panel admin: no dense data tables, dashboard walls, or office-console layouts for field workflows.
Don't use AI beige/cream: no cream, sand, parchment, paper, ivory, or warm-neutral body backgrounds as a shortcut to warmth.
Don't use side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism, hero-metric templates, or identical decorative card grids.
Don't add new hard-coded colors in screens. Route color through Color.kt, Theme.kt, and MaterialTheme.
Don't use text glyphs or emoji as icons. The regression test blocks camera, map, leaf, image, and info text glyphs in presentation code.
